x.title: of pairs, the second finish quicker

method: Consecutive finishes of one record linked by name (a candidate, not a verified person), in race-date order from the weather evidence: 5,352 doubles 1 to 21 days apart at two different races (mainly Washington then New York, Berlin then Chicago, Berlin then Amsterdam and Boston then London), against 13,964 pairs 301 to 430 days apart at the same two races in the same order, reweighted within each band to the doubles' mix of race pairs (race pairs with at least 10 such pairs in the band). Each pair is banded by the mean of its two finish times rather than the first, so no regression to the mean is built into either group. Doubles are noisier pairs: under 3:30, the two finishes differ by more than 10% in 18% of doubles against 13% of year-on pairs. The share of pairs whose second finish was quicker; ties count as not quicker.
